title.zh: 聊天能力对齐与代码块体验修复
title.en: Chat parity and code block fixes

zh: 工作台聊天支持操作审批、权限设置与子 Agent，与 Desktop 保持一致。
en: Workbench chat now supports action approvals, permission settings, and sub-agents, matching Desktop.

zh: 结构面板完整列出项目中的全部 Velar 源文件；运行档位恢复完整三档；状态栏更新进度改为与主题一致的轻量样式。
主题强调色只有一个来源，弹出菜单与主界面颜色保持一致。
回复输出过程中代码块不再反复刷新：点开的代码块保持展开，短代码块直接完整显示，鼠标停在代码块上页面可正常滚动。
模型长时间思考时显示「思考中」，只有真正断网重试时才显示「重连中」。
en: The structure panel now lists every Velar source file in the project, all three run profiles are available again, and the status-bar update progress uses a light, theme-matched style.
The theme accent now has a single source, so popovers match the main window.
Code blocks no longer refresh repeatedly while a reply streams: expanded blocks stay open, short blocks are shown in full, and the page scrolls normally over code blocks.
Long model pauses now show “Thinking”; “Reconnecting” only appears when a real network retry happens.

zh: 让本地发布工作流校验同时兼容 LF 与 CRLF 检出，确保 Windows 原生发布门禁稳定通过。
en: Made local release-workflow verification accept both LF and CRLF checkouts so the native Windows release gate remains deterministic.

title.zh: 游戏预览鼠标锁定修复
title.en: Pointer lock fix for game previews

zh: 修复 OpenVoxel 等游戏预览点击后无法锁定鼠标的问题，恢复依赖鼠标锁定的视角转向和键盘移动。
en: Fixed pointer lock after clicking game previews such as OpenVoxel, restoring mouse look and keyboard movement that depend on pointer lock.

title.zh: 统一且可靠的侧栏聊天

zh: 通过 Platform UI 与 Desktop 共用聊天组件和交互逻辑，同时保留 Workbench 专属组合边界。
en: Shared chat components and interaction logic with Desktop through Platform UI while preserving Workbench-specific composition.

zh: 将聊天内容限制在可调整宽度的侧栏内，并恢复稳定滚动、导航、紧凑代码块与更新进度显示。
让终止状态可靠收敛，并在取消运行时终止由 Workbench 持有的命令进程。
en: Kept chat content within the resizable sidebar and restored stable scrolling, navigation, compact code blocks, and update progress.
Made stop settlement deterministic and terminated Workbench-owned command processes when a run was cancelled.

title.zh: 跨平台语言服务与发布修复
title.en: Cross-platform language service and release fixes

zh: 规范化 Windows LSP 文件 URI，使诊断可靠映射回已打开的文档。
保持 macOS 发布路径检查确定，并继续在各原生平台独立发布。
en: Canonicalized Windows LSP file URIs so diagnostics map back to open documents reliably.
Kept macOS release path checks deterministic and preserved independent native-platform publication.

zh: 升级 System 至 1.1.16，并将直接与传递 Platform 依赖锁定到对应正式版本。
通过本地签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated System to 1.1.16 and locked direct and transitive Platform dependencies to their corresponding published versions.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local signing and notarization path.

zh: 将全部直接 Platform 包升级到 Platform 0.6.32 发布版本，并保持精确不可变依赖。
通过本地 Mac 签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated every direct Platform package to the Platform 0.6.32 release while retaining exact immutable dependencies.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local Mac signing and notarization path.

zh: macOS、Windows 与 Linux 的打包结果现在可以独立发布。
en: macOS, Windows, and Linux packaging results can now be published independently.

zh: 单个平台失败或不可用不再阻塞已成功平台生成签名候选目录。
后续平台运行会追加已验证资产，而不会替换先前发布的下载。
en: A failed or unavailable platform no longer blocks successful platforms from producing a signed candidate catalog.
Later platform runs append verified assets without replacing previously published downloads.

zh: 统一分支选择菜单在普通与懒加载状态下的边框、背景和阴影。
修复搜索区域与窗口拖拽冲突，并让浮层正确自动聚焦和恢复焦点。
en: Unified branch-menu borders, backgrounds, and shadows across normal and lazy-loaded states.
Fixed conflicts with window dragging and restored correct autofocus and focus return for overlays.

zh: 对齐 Platform 工具安全边界，强化浏览器脚本、Windows 命令路径与破坏性命令识别。
加强 Office 预览净化和媒体路径校验，避免不可信内容进入预览。
将路径提示改为线性扫描，并收紧跨平台路径、模型别名和工具结果解析。
en: Aligned Platform tool-safety boundaries for browser scripts, Windows command paths, and destructive-command detection.
Hardened Office preview sanitization and media-path validation against untrusted content.
Moved path suggestions to linear scanning and tightened cross-platform path, model-alias, and tool-result parsing.

zh: 为模型配置和托管模型目录加入可订阅更新，使已打开的界面在刷新后立即同步。
en: Added subscriptions for model configuration and managed catalogs so open interfaces update immediately after refresh.

zh: 稳定显示 VelarOS 与 VelarOS-Dev，并明确标记暂时不可用的服务。
刷新期间保留最后一次成功快照，并拒绝过期界面状态提交的模型选择。
en: Stabilized VelarOS and VelarOS-Dev display names and clearly marked temporarily unavailable services.
Kept the last successful snapshot during refresh and rejected model selections submitted from stale interface state.

title.zh: 可信发布与启动体积门禁

zh: 重构更新发布事务，记录原生平台、架构、签名状态和验证证据，并在 completion 前验证远端字节与签名目录。
新增 main、renderer 及首屏资源体积预算，防止启动成本回归。
en: Reworked the update transaction to record native platform, architecture, signature state, and evidence, then verify remote bytes and the signed catalog before completion.
Added size budgets for main, renderer, and startup resources to prevent startup-cost regressions.

zh: 升级共享 Platform 执行栈，修正取消语义并收窄语言操作的运行时依赖边界。
en: Updated the shared Platform execution stack, corrected cancellation semantics, and narrowed language-operation runtime dependencies.

title.zh: 预览交互与共享执行栈

zh: 图片预览加入缩放、适应窗口、快捷键和放大后拖动。
Agent 与行内补全接入共享执行及模型请求栈，同时保留真实工具 schema 和调用身份。
en: Added zoom controls, fit-to-window, shortcuts, and panning for enlarged image previews.
Moved Agent execution and inline completion onto shared execution and model-request stacks while preserving real tool schemas and call identity.

zh: 改进终端输出高亮和控制序列处理，使内容与工具面板样式保持一致。
en: Improved terminal highlighting and control-sequence handling so output remains consistent with tool-panel styling.
